en: Yesterday: take a wolf, a goat, and a cabbage across a river, in a boat that holds Person one, and only one more thing.
Here is the trick. First, take the goat across. Then come back alone.
Next, take the wolf across. But bring the goat back with you.
Leave the goat, and take the cabbage across. The wolf does not eat cabbage.
Come back alone. Then take the goat across, one last time.
All three are safe, on the other side.
Two fathers and two sons go fishing together.
Each of them takes home one whole fish. Nobody shares.
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
